title.narrative: Improvement of the capacities of the Inter American Court of Human Rights, phase II

description.narrative: Contract aimed at improving the capacities of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights to administer prompt justice to victims of human rights violations, especially those belonging to vulnerable and traditionally discriminated groups. It should also strengthen the capacities of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights in monitoring of compliance with judgments and implementation of provisional measures, enhance its ability to monitor the impact of its advisory opinions, disseminate the Inter-American Court of Human Rights¿ case-law and work in an amicable manner, that facilitates its observance and use among national actors and disseminate its jurisprudence and work through training activities
